name: Hallway propped-phone body check

source.platform: TikTok video (6.1 s, 1080x1920 HEVC, 29.97 fps, 183 frames)

summary: Decoded video frame 40: a phone propped low on a kitchen counter films a woman standing about two metres away in a narrow apartment hallway in front of a plain white closet door; the upward angle gives a big band of ceiling with an unlit recessed puck light, cuts her off at the upper thigh, and bends the door verticals; soft off-camera window daylight, flat phone-video HDR, blurred hands mid-swing and a four-line lowercase white caption in the upper third.

colors.white_balance: neutral-to-warm daylight read; white walls and door render as warm off-white and greige, never blue
colors.contrast: low to medium; soft shadows, no pure black except the dark leggings, highlights on the door stay just under clipping
colors.saturation: muted and slightly desaturated overall; skin is the warmest, most saturated area; the rest of the frame is whites, greige and taupe
notable_casts: warm yellow-beige cast on the shadowed walls and ceiling
brownish falloff on the wall at frame right
slight magenta-warm tint in skin shadows from phone-video processing

sources: large window off-camera at front-left behind the phone, overcast or indirect daylight
no artificial light on; the recessed ceiling light is off
lighting.direction: front and slightly left of the subject, falling off toward the ceiling and the right-hand wall
lighting.hardness: soft and wrapping; faint shadow under the chest band and beside the waist, no hard cast shadows
artifacts: ceiling and upper corner fall into warm grey shadow
door panels lit brighter than the surrounding wall
gentle gradient from lit door to darker right wall

camera.implied_device: iPhone rear main camera recording 1080p video, phone propped upright on a kitchen counter or island, re-encoded by TikTok
camera.focal_length_equiv: about 26 mm equivalent (rear main); the front camera at about 23 mm is also plausible
camera.angle: low angle from roughly hip height, lens tilted upward about 10 degrees
camera.distance: about 1.8 to 2.2 m from the subject
camera.depth_of_field: deep; door, switch plate and subject all acceptably sharp, detail limited by video compression rather than blur

composition.framing: three-quarter body: top of head to upper thigh, cropped through the legs at the bottom edge
composition.subject_placement: centred horizontally, head at about 42 percent of the frame height, torso filling the middle third
composition.tilt: upward keystone: the door frame and wall corners lean inward toward the top; horizon itself close to level, about 1 degree clockwise
composition.foreground: the white edge of a countertop cuts into the bottom-right corner, slightly out of focus
composition.background: white two-panel interior door with brushed-nickel hinges in a white casing, off-white drywall, a white rocker light switch at left, a black plug-in device in a low outlet at lower left, a bulkhead soffit and a sliver of the next room with a yellow object at the right edge
composition.negative_space: large: the top 35 to 40 percent of the frame is plain ceiling and soffit, where the caption sits

subject_treatment.pose_type: standing square to the camera mid-step or mid-gesture, arms loose at the sides and swinging, talking to camera
subject_treatment.face_visibility: full face visible, looking straight into the lens
subject_treatment.wardrobe_category: two-tone layered scoop-neck sports bra and dark low-rise leggings; midriff visible
props: a small blurred item in one hand (hair tie or earbud case)
no phone in frame; the phone is the camera

environment: Rental-style apartment interior: narrow hallway between kitchen and bedroom with a white paneled closet door, flat off-white walls, flat ceiling with a recessed can light, builder-grade switch plates and outlets; the camera sits on the kitchen counter looking into the hallway. Tidy but lived-in, nothing styled.
effects_imperfections: motion blur on both hands and forearms from arms swinging during the clip
video-frame softness: fine detail smeared by 1080p recording and TikTok HEVC re-encode
macroblocking and banding in the flat ceiling gradient
low-light luminance noise in the upper ceiling corner
upward keystone distortion leaning the door frame and wall corners
out-of-focus counter edge intruding at bottom right
legs cropped at the upper thigh by the low propped angle
flat, slightly washed phone-video HDR tone curve
stray background details left in: switch plate, plugged-in device at a low outlet, a yellow object in the next room

typography_overlay.text: literally have never been in better shape since i started incorporating minimum 4 mile walks everyday into my workout routine
typography_overlay.text_style: TikTok in-app Classic font (clean geometric sans), all lowercase, centre-aligned
typography_overlay.relative_size: small: each line about 2.5 percent of the frame height; block about 60 percent of the frame width
typography_overlay.position: upper third, horizontally centred, roughly 19 to 26 percent from the top, over the plain ceiling and soffit
typography_overlay.shadow_or_stroke: faint soft drop shadow, no stroke, no background box

mood: casual, confident, unposed talk-to-camera update from someone's own hallway; proof-of-routine rather than a photo shoot
reusable_prompt_fragment: phone propped low on a kitchen counter filming vertical 1080p video, low upward angle from hip height, woman standing about two metres away in a narrow apartment hallway in front of a plain white paneled door, head-to-upper-thigh framing, big band of plain ceiling with an unlit recessed light, soft off-camera window daylight, warm off-white and greige walls, muted colour, flat phone-video HDR, hands blurred mid-swing, counter edge in the bottom corner, compression softness and ceiling banding
avoid: a mirror or a hand-held selfie arm (the phone is propped and unseen)
tripod-perfect eye-level framing or centred symmetry with straight verticals
ring light, studio softbox or golden-hour glow
styled or decorated interiors, plants and art arranged for the camera
crisp still-photo detail instead of video-frame softness
saturated or graded colour, teal-orange looks
frozen hands in a posed position
excerlock_fit: Hook or proof slide for a walking-changed-my-body slideshow: the propped talk-to-camera body check carries the claim; the upper-third ceiling space holds the hook caption added in the editor. Pairs with a steps receipt as the proof slide.
